title: Amonian
summary: AMO'NIAN, adjective [from Amon or Hamon, a title of Jupiter, or rather of the sun. Heb.] Pertaining to Jupiter Amon, or to his temple and worship in upper Egypt.

inlines.v: AMO'NIAN, adjective [from Amon or Hamon, a title of Jupiter, or rather of the sun. Heb.] Pertaining to Jupiter Amon, or to his temple and worship in upper Egypt.
